metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Kyiv decrease in March 2022 compared to January 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band (DNB) data - Collection: "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" - Two periods: January 2022 and March 2022 - Location: Kyiv, Ukraine (approximately 50.45°N, 30.52°E) 2. Masking strategy: - Nighttime lights don't need cloud masking in the same way - Use the avg_rad band which is the average radiance - Filter out low quality pixels if needed using the cf_cvg band 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If March intensity is lower than January, answer A (Yes, it decreased) - If March >= January, answer B (No, it didn't decrease) - C1: If no images found for either period - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels after processing - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Kyiv geometry (city center and surrounding area) const kyiv = ee.Geometry.Point([30.5234, 50.4501]).buffer(10000); // 10km radius // 2. Load VIIRS Nighttime Lights data const viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG'); // January 2022 const jan2022 = viirs .filterDate('2022-01-01', '2022-01-31') .filterBounds(kyiv); // March 2022 const mar2022 = viirs .filterDate('2022-03-01', '2022-03-31') .filterBounds(kyiv); // 3. Check collection sizes const janSize = jan2022.size().getInfo(); const marSize = mar2022.size().getInfo(); console.log('January 2022 Images:', janSize); console.log('March 2022 Images:', marSize); if (janSize === 0 || marSize === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Get mean composites const janImage = jan2022.select('avg_rad').mean(); const marImage = mar2022.select('avg_rad').mean(); // 5. Calculate statistics with pixel count validation const janStats = janImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: kyiv, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const marStats = marImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: kyiv, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const janMean = janStats['avg_rad_mean']; const janCount = janStats['avg_rad_count']; const marMean = marStats['avg_rad_mean']; const marCount = marStats['avg_rad_count']; console.log('January 2022 - Mean:', janMean, 'Pixels:', janCount); console.log('March 2022 - Mean:', marMean, 'Pixels:', marCount); // 6. Validate pixel counts if (janCount === 0 || marCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 7. Validate calculation results if (janMean === null || janMean === undefined || marMean === null || marMean === undefined) { console.log('Calculation returned null/undefined.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (isNaN(janMean) || isNaN(marMean)) { console.log('Calculation returned NaN.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Compare and determine answer const percentChange = ((marMean - janMean) / janMean * 100).toFixed(2); console.log('Change:', percentChange + '%'); if (marMean < janMean) { console.log('March nighttime lights decreased compared to January.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('March nighttime lights did not decrease compared to January.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
